description: A MineBerry Bedwars quality-of-life mod featuring player stats, metrics, automation, and utility commands.
longDescription: A Minecraft mod for the Mineberry Bedwars server. Adds in-game commands for checking player stats and performance metrics, plus small automation utilities like automatic good-game / good-luck messages and a toggleable auto-join assistant.
statusNote: This project is archived and no longer maintained. It was developed several years ago and some features, dependencies, or functionality may no longer work as expected. Preserved for reference.

commands.desc: View detailed stats for any username.
View a metrics/performance breakdown for a player.
Auto-send a good-game message when a match ends.
Auto-send a good-luck message at the start of a match.
Toggle the auto-join assistant / category menu.
